title: Senior Devops Engineer (Kubernetes & Cloud Infrastructure) Pj
description: Qual será o seu papel? Administração de Ambientes Híbridos: Gerenciar e implantar clusters Kubernetes tanto em ambientes On-Premises (usando kubeadm) quanto em nuvens públicas. Gestão de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Provisionar e manter recursos de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform e Ansible, garantindo a escalabilidade do ambiente. Otimização e Segurança de Containers: Criar e otimizar imagens Docker, além de gerenciar políticas de segurança, RBAC, quotas e namespaces no ecossistema Kubernetes. Sustentação e Troubleshooting: Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos em pods, nós e serviços, utilizando ferramentas nativas e CLI de nuvem. Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementar e analisar métricas e logs para garantir a saúde dos clusters e identificar gargalos de performance (CPU, memória, IOPS) de forma proativa. Esperamos que você tenha: Domínio de Kubernetes: Experiência avançada em configuração de redes (CNI/Cilium), serviços (LoadBalancer, Ingress) e Service Mesh (Istio). Experiência com Armazenamento: Sólido conhecimento em PVs, PVCs e provisionadores de storage (Ceph, NFS ou nativos de nuvem como EBS/Azure Disk). Fluência em Automação e CI/CD: Experiência prática na construção de pipelines e integração de automações com GitLab CI/CD e ArgoCD. Conhecimento em Observabilidade: Experiência técnica com a stack Prometheus, Grafana e Alertmanager, além de gestão de logs (Fluentd, Loki, Elasticsearch). Habilidade com IaC e Helm: Proficiência em Terraform, Ansible e no empacotamento/deploy de aplicações via Helm Charts. Vamos ficar felizes se você tiver (seu diferencial): Multicloud: Vivência em múltiplos provedores de nuvem (GCP, OCI, AWS, Azure). Foco em Segurança: Experiência avançada na implementação de políticas de segurança de rede e endurecimento (hardening) de imagens Docker. Mentalidade Proativa: Capacidade comprovada de antecipar incidentes graves através da análise técnica de recursos de infraestrutura. Certificações nos provedores de Cloud (OCI, AWS, GCP, Azure) Contratação: PJ.

O que oferecemos Trabalho 100% remoto. Contratação PJ com remuneração competitiva. Flexibilidade de horário. Ambiente colaborativo e orientado a dados. Programa de capacitação continuada. Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em projetos internacionais e desafiadores.

Domínio de sistemas ERP e ferramentas de análise (Excel/Google Sheets). Também é legal se você tiver: Pós-graduação ou especialização em Finanças, Controladoria ou áreas correlatas;

Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos;

title: Language Specialist
description: Job Title: Language Specialist – AI Training (Freelancer) Location: Brazil (Remote – Candidates must be based in Brazil) About the Role: As a Language Specialist, you will play a vital role in training and enhancing Large Language Models (LLMs). This involves evaluating prompts, rating AI-generated outputs, and creating high-quality content to improve the accuracy, fluency, and cultural relevance of AI systems used by global technology leaders. Key Responsibilities: Evaluate AI-generated prompts and responses for linguistic accuracy, coherence, and contextual relevance. Provide structured ratings and feedback on AI outputs, highlighting errors, biases, or inconsistencies. Develop, edit, and curate high-quality content for training datasets across diverse domains. Collaborate with linguists, annotators, and AI researchers to refine model performance. Ensure cultural and linguistic nuances are accurately represented. Follow established guidelines while also suggesting improvements for evaluation frameworks. Qualifications: Strong written and spoken command of the target language, with excellent grammar and stylistic skills. Prior experience in content writing, editing, or evaluation preferred. Analytical mindset with keen attention to detail. Interest in AI, NLP, or LLMs will be an advantage.

title: Parceiro De Vendas
description:
Seja um Parceiro Estratégico do Grupo AG Capital, a Primeira TaxTech do Brasil. Você é um consultor, comercial ou líder de negócios com acesso a decisores C-level? Já recuperamos mais de R$ 8 bilhões em tributos para mais de 12.000 clientes, incluindo 15% das empresas listadas na B3, e queremos que você faça parte desta história de sucesso. Nossa missão é transformar a complexidade tributária brasileira em fluxo de caixa e compliance para as empresas, através de tecnologia proprietária e uma metodologia exclusiva. Para acelerar essa missão, buscamos parceiros que compartilhem da nossa visão e queiram crescer conosco. Quem Buscamos? Possui um relacionamento de confiança com CFOs, CHROs e CEOs de médias e grandes empresas, especialmente as de Lucro Presumido ou Real? Nosso modelo de remuneração 100% no êxito é um dos nossos maiores diferenciais. Buscamos parceiros que saibam comunicar o poder de uma proposta de valor de risco zero. 3) Mentalidade\ "TaxTech\" Você vê a tecnologia como o futuro da gestão fiscal? Com nossa plataforma proprietária Athena™, analisamos 100% dos dados fiscais sem amostragem, garantindo precisão e escala incomparáveis. Buscamos parceiros que queiram liderar a transformação digital no setor tributário. O que Oferecemos à sua Parceria: - Portfólio de Alto Valor: Adicione as soluções AG, AG Tax e Agnes ao seu portfólio e resolva dores latentes de seus clientes.

- Diferencial Competitivo: Ofereça aos seus clientes uma solução inovadora que a concorrência não possui, fortalecendo seu próprio posicionamento como consultor estratégico. Você se identifica com este perfil? Se você é um profissional visionário, com uma carteira de clientes consolidada e o desejo de gerar um impacto financeiro real para seus clientes e para o seu negócio, queremos conversar com você. Clique no link para saber mais e iniciar sua jornada como Parceiro Estratégico do Grupo AG Capital. #AGCapital #ParceriaEstrategica #TaxTech #ConsultoriaTributaria #Consultoria #AdvocaciaEmpresarial #RecuperacaoTributaria #InovacaoFiscal #Finanças #Contabilidade #eSocial #LucroReal#Vendas

title: English Teacher
description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Business Intelligence Developer (Remote)
description: A Brunel está apoiando uma consultoria de dados na busca por um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) de BI Pleno para atuar na construção e evolução de soluções analíticas, com forte ênfase em engenharia de dados. A atuação envolve contato frequente com interlocutores internacionais, por isso o inglês é essencial para o dia a dia (reuniões, alinhamentos e documentação). O dia a dia inclui desde a modelagem e transformação de dados até a entrega de dashboards e relatórios que suportem a tomada de decisão. A pessoa ideal combina domínio técnico em ferramentas de BI com sólida experiência em SQL e scripting para manipulação de dados em escala. Responsabilidades Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e soluções analíticas em Power BI ou Qlik (Sense/SaaS). Escrever e otimizar queries complexas em SQL para extração, transformação e carga de dados (ETL/ELT). Modelar dados dimensionais e relacionais, garantindo performance e escalabilidade das soluções. Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados utilizando scripts em SQL, Python ou outras linguagens pertinentes. Conectar e integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (bancos relacionais, APIs, arquivos flat, data lakes). Documentar processos, modelos de dados e regras de negócio de forma clara e acessível. Colaborar com times multidisciplinares (produto, engenharia, negócios) para traduzir necessidades em soluções de dados. Participar de code reviews e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de dados. Requisitos Experiência consolidada (3+ anos) com desenvolvimento de BI e/ou engenharia de dados. Domínio avançado de SQL (CTEs, window functions, otimização de queries, stored procedures). Experiência prática com Power BI (DAX, Power Query/M) e/ou Qlik (script de carga, set analysis). Conhecimento em modelagem de dados (star schema, snowflake, Data Vault). Experiência com pelo menos um banco de dados relacional (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Oracle ou similar). Familiaridade com conceitos e ferramentas de ETL/ELT. Inglês avançado ou fluente, uso diário em reuniões e comunicação com times internacionais. Diferenciais Experiência com Python para manipulação e automação de dados. Vivência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (especialmente Snowflake). Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, dbt, Azure Data Factory, SSIS). Experiência com versionamento de código (Git). Familiaridade com práticas de DataOps e CI/CD aplicadas a dados. O que oferecemos Trabalho 100% remoto. Contratação PJ com remuneração competitiva. Flexibilidade de horário. Ambiente colaborativo e orientado a dados. Programa de capacitação continuada. Oportunidade de crescimento e atuação em projetos internacionais e desafiadores.

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.Com The Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group. In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations. As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini’s M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini’s deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization. Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini’s M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini’s LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time. Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency. Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required. Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description: Position Scope The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region. This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets. Responsibilities and Accountabilities Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding. Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers. Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency. Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards. Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments. Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes. Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency. Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs. Mandatory Requirements Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments. Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape, including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks. Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes. Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and\ "Control Tower\" operationalmodels. Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments. Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR). Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field. Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination. Desirable Requirements Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree. Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience. Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools. Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.G., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

BRQ WAY No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são. Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente. Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país! O que procuramos? Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação! O que você deve ter? Precisamos de um profissional auto-didata que conheça front-end esejáveis React/Angular O profissional vai trabalhar em conjunto com o time de IA do Fusion, deve conhecer as IDEs de mercado VS Code e Cursor e como utilizar IA, deve conhecer o uso de Prompts e RAG, e ter noção do que sao agentes de IA. Conhecimentos de banco de dados e cloud sao um diferencial. Fundamental ter conhecimentos de Design System e Figma. O que temos pra te oferecer? Mais do que um plano de carreira! A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas: - Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos! - Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.
- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.
- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio. E os benefícios? Plano de Saúde;
Plano Odontológico;
Seguro de Vida;
Vale Refeição;
Vale Alimentação;
Horário Flexível;
Home Office;
Gympass, Telemedicina,Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais! Como é trabalhar na BRQ? Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.Com/brqdigitalsolutions Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Salesforce Administrator
description: Job Title: Salesforce Administrator Location: Remote (LATAM) Duration: 6months Role Overview We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Salesforce Administrator to manage, configure, and optimize our Salesforce platform. title: Salesforce Business System Analyst
description: Job Title: Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA) Location: LATAM Duration: 6-12months Job Summary: We are looking for a Salesforce Business Systems Analyst (BSA) with strong experience in gathering business requirements, translating them into functional specifications, and supporting Salesforce implementation and enhancements. The ideal candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, product owners, and technical teams to deliver scalable Salesforce solutions that support business processes. Key Responsibilities: ·Work with business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements for Salesforce implementations and enhancements. ·Translate business needs into functional requirements, user stories, and process flows. ·Act as a bridge between business teams and technical teams to ensure accurate implementation of requirements. ·Configure and support Salesforce features including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, workflows, validation rules, reports, and dashboards. ·Participate in solution design discussions and recommend best practices within the Salesforce ecosystem. ·Support UAT (User Acceptance Testing) by preparing test cases, coordinating with stakeholders, and ensuring requirements are met. ·Assist in data migration, integration requirements, and system documentation. ·Provide production support and troubleshooting for Salesforce issues. ·Maintain clear documentation including BRDs, FRDs, user stories, and process diagrams. ·Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive continuous improvement and system optimization. Required Qualifications: ·3–6 years of experience as a Business Analyst with Salesforce platform exposure. ·Strong understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud. ·Experience with requirements gathering, documentation, and stakeholder management. ·Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies. ·Ability to create user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional specifications. ·Experience with Salesforce reporting, dashboards, and basic configuration. ·Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills

title: Market Data Database Support Engineer
description: Company Description Amaris Consulting is an independent technology consulting firm with a global footprint, bringing together diverse talents from various backgrounds to deliver innovative solutions to clients worldwide. About the Role We are looking for a highly analytical Market Data Database Engineer support a market data platform handling real-time financial data and time-series database. This role is focused on production support, deep diagnosis, and database troubleshooting in a fast-paced capital markets environment, working closely with traders, vendors, and engineering teams. Key Responsibilities Perform advanced diagnosis and root cause analysis of production incidents related to market data systems Support and troubleshoot time-series databases Analyze data quality issues (missing, delayed, or incorrect market data) Investigate system behavior using logs, queries, and system-level tools Work with real-time data distribution systems (TREP / RTDS) Validate data using tools such as Refinitiv SLang Collaborate with vendors (e.G. London Stock Exchange Group (LSEG), Bloomberg) to resolve data-related issues Support incident management processes and ensure timely resolution Develop small scripts (Python/Bash/PowerShell) for troubleshooting and automation Contribute to continuous improvement of monitoring, alerting, and support processes Must-Have Skills Strong experience in production support / application support Proven expertise in diagnosis and root cause analysis (RCA) Solid experience with databases (performance analysis, data validation) Hands-on experience with debugging, troubleshooting, and log analysis Good scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar) Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to work under pressure Nice-to-Have Experience in banking / capital markets / trading environments Knowledge of market data systems (TREP / RTDS) Experience with Refinitiv SLang Familiarity with Process Monitor (ProcMon) or similar diagnostic tools Exposure to Bloomberg or Refinitiv/LSEG data platforms What We’re Looking For Strong investigative mindset – you enjoy digging into complex issues Ability to trace problems across multiple layers (data source → ingestion → database → application) Excellent communication skills and ability to work with global stakeholders Structured and analytical thinking Proactive approach to identifying and solving issues What We Offer? A modern, dynamic, and future-oriented environment within a top global institution Flexible working arrangements – fully remote or hybrid options Continuous learning and certification opportunities Competitive salary and benefits package Long-term career prospects with international exposure Inclusive, multicultural team with regular knowledge-sharing and team events

title: Direct Response Ads | Video Editor
description: About Hydroh: We’re one of the fastest-growing Shopify-based DTC brands in the world at the forefront of all things hydrogen water. Our product line includes hydrogen water bottles, supplements, and accessories all designed to help people recover faster, reduce inflammation, and feel their best. We’re looking for a Performance Video Editor who deeply understands how to cut direct response ads for Meta (Facebook/Instagram), TikTok, and YouTube Shorts. This is NOT a branding video role we’re talking scroll-stopping hooks, retention-driven pacing, and revenue-first editing. Compensation & Perks: Base Salary + Performance Bonus (Depending on experience and skillset) Full-Time, 40 hours per week (Flexible Schedule just a few hours overlap with EST is fine) Fully Remote Resources, trainings, and courses covered we invest in our people. What We're Looking For 2+ years experience editing direct response video ads for DTC brands Portfolio of paid ads you've edited (Meta, TikTok, YT Shorts — performance-focused) Advanced skills in Adobe Premiere, After Effects, or equivalent Strong understanding of performance editing — you know what makes a video convert Experience editing UGC-style content, influencer videos, and testimonial formats Ability to follow creative briefs and storyboards, but also contribute your own ideas Comfortable with iterating quickly based on feedback and performance data Clear communicator and proactive with timelines Bonus Points: Experience working with health & wellness or skincare brands Familiarity with tools like Frame.Io, Slack, and Notion Understanding of hooks, angles, and stages of awareness Editing for long-form VSLs What you'll be doing: Edit short-form performance videos (15–90 seconds) optimized for Meta and TikTok Implement scroll-stopping hooks, fast-paced edits, dynamic subtitles, and retention overlays Work closely with our Creative Strategist and UGC Project Manager to execute on weekly ad briefs Repurpose UGC content, testimonials, and influencer clips into winning ad angles Apply performance data to iterate and improve ad creatives week over week Deliver assets fast we move quickly and expect tight turnaround when needed How to apply? Apply directly via LinkedIn Attach your resume and portfolio of previous works We’re looking to hire immediately — so if you’re an editor who gets performance, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Immigration Paralegal
description: Company Description Brooks Law Firm is a trusted legal practice dedicated to serving clients in immigration, personal injury, social security disability, and workers' compensation. We are proudly committed to supporting Spanish-speaking and Brazilian Portuguese-speaking communities, and we work closely with organizations such as the Brazilian Workers Center. Our team provides expert legal guidance across a wide range of matters — including family-based green cards, deportation defense, personal injury claims, and workers' compensation — with a strong emphasis on client satisfaction, clear communication, and personalized service in multiple languages. Role Description We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Family-Based Immigration Paralegal to join our team remotely. In this role, you will work closely with our attorneys to prepare and manage family-based immigration cases from start to finish. The ideal candidate is proactive, client-focused, and thrives in a fast-paced legal environment. Key Responsibilities Prepare and file family-based immigration petitions and applications, including forms I-130, I-485, I-765, I-131, and all related supporting documents Collect, review, and organize client documentation to ensure completeness and accuracy Maintain and manage case files, deadlines, and follow-ups Communicate with clients to provide case updates, request documents, and respond to general inquiries Assist in preparing clients for USCIS interviews, including document review and guidance Draft cover letters, affidavits, and other supporting materials Monitor case progress and assist in responding to Requests for Evidence (RFEs) Coordinate with attorneys to ensure timely filings and full compliance with immigration regulations Handle all client information with the utmost confidentiality and professionalism Qualifications Prior experience in immigration law, specifically in family-based cases Strong working knowledge of USCIS forms and procedures Excellent organizational and time-management skills Strong written and verbal communication abilities Ability to manage multiple cases simultaneously in a fast-paced environment Bilingual in English and Portuguese is required — Portuguese speakers only To Apply To be considered for this position, all applications must be submitted by email to. Please include your resume and a brief description of your relevant experience.

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM;

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). title: Senior/Staff Platform Software Engineer
description: We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior/Staff Platform Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience to join our U.S. client. The role focuses on designing, building, and evolving the foundational systems that power the products. This role requires an experienced engineer with strong hands-on expertise in PHP and TypeScript (Angular) who can operate with minimal oversight and deliver pragmatic, customer-focused solutions. The ideal candidate is an engineer who already possesses deep technical expertise, architectural judgment, and product-oriented thinking — and can apply those skills immediately in a production environment. Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class property management system integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind. Responsibilities Design and implement scalable platform services using PHP as a primary backend language Build and maintain frontend systems using TypeScript and Angular Architect and evolve shared platform capabilities used across multiple products and teams Translate product requirements into pragmatic, maintainable technical solutions Apply Domain-Driven Design (DDD) principles and architectural modeling to complex business domains Make sound tradeoffs between ideal architecture and practical delivery timelines Build and integrate systems leveraging LLM-based tools to accelerate development workflows Design and implement features powered by LLMs and agent-based systems, including orchestration, evaluation, and observability Improve engineering velocity through tooling, automation, and thoughtful system design Collaborate cross-functionally with product and design teams to ensure technical decisions align with customer needs Contribute to cloud architecture decisions and ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost-aware Required Experience Excellent English communication skills 7+ years of professional software engineering experience Deep, production-grade experience with PHP Strong front-end development experience using TypeScript and Angular Experience designing and operating distributed systems in production Strong understanding of API design, RESTful services, and event-driven systems and solid knowledge of relational databases and data modeling Practical experience applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) concepts and architectural models (layered architecture, hexagonal/clean architecture, event-driven architecture, etc.) Demonstrated ability to evolve legacy systems incrementally Ability to design systems that balance correctness, scalability, cost, and delivery speed Hands-on experience deploying and operating systems in AWS, with familiarity with core AWS services (e.G., EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, RDS, S3, API Gateway, CloudWatch, IAM) and strong understanding of cloud-native patterns, scalability, reliability, and cost optimization Experience with infrastructure-as-code (e.G., Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK) is strongly preferred Hands-on experience using LLM-based tools in daily development workflows Experience integrating LLM APIs into production systems Familiarity with prompt design, evaluation strategies, and reliability patterns Ideally: experience building features or internal tools powered by LLM agents, including orchestration, tool use, guardrails, and monitoring Strong product mindset with p ragmatic decision-maker — prioritizes customer impact over theoretical purity and avoids dogmatic adherence to patterns or tools Experience making technical tradeoffs in ambiguous environments Ability to reason about cost, complexity, maintainability, and time-to-market Highly self-motivated and accountable, with the ability to drive initiatives independently from concept to production with minimal oversight Comfortable operating in environments with evolving requirements Desired Experience Experience with other major cloud providers (GCP or Azure) is a plus Experience defining platform strategy or technical direction across teams Experience mentoring engineers and raising overall engineering standards Proven track record of modernizing systems at scale Experience designing developer platforms or internal tooling ecosystems Strong opinions loosely held — able to debate rigorously and adapt when new information emerges Additional Information Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big! You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions Work with smart and creative people Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent! We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you! 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays Start: ASAP About Velozient We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Analista De P&D - Golang/C++
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo? Então essa é a sua chance! Buscamos: Analista de P&D - Golang/C++ Resumo do Propósito da Função: Esta função oferece uma empolgante posição de desenvolvimento de software na equipe de Engenharia, uma organização multicultural com times baseados na Europa e na América do Sul, responsável por pesquisar e desenvolver soluções de hardware e software para sistemas de medição de audiência utilizados globalmente. Este profissional fará parte da equipe responsável pelos sistemas de correspondência de áudio desenvolvidos pelo IBOPE, que estão sendo implementados em diversos países. Esse sistema compara áudios coletados por dispositivos de medição dedicados com uma biblioteca de conteúdos de TV, utilizando a tecnologia proprietária de correspondência de áudio do IBOPE (técnica de fingerprinting). O IBOPE possui sistemas desenvolvidos tanto para ambientes on-premises quanto em nuvem, utilizando uma abordagem agnóstica de cloud. Sua arquitetura é composta por diversas tecnologias de ponta, como containers, Kubernetes, entre outras. Esta função envolve: Manutenção de tecnologias existentes baseadas em Linux para ambientes on-premises. Pesquisa, criação e desenvolvimento de aplicações — baseadas em charts do Kubernetes e/ou disponíveis na CNCF (Cloud Native Computing Foundation) — responsáveis por comunicação, busca otimizada em grandes volumes de dados, armazenamento de dados e mais, utilizando tecnologias e técnicas avançadas. Manutenção de pipelines. Melhoria do código por meio da adição de ferramentas para avaliação da qualidade do código. RESPONSABILIDADES: Manter tecnologias existentes implantadas em vários países. Implementar novas tecnologias para sistemas de medição de audiência com base em tecnologias existentes e novas. Pesquisar novas tecnologias para aprimorar o produto. Desenvolver novos serviços. Criar novos charts do Kubernetes. Garantir a comunicação dos containers Kubernetes dentro e fora dos clusters. Manter a tecnologia atual. REQUISITOS: Essencial: Superior completo ou cursando último ano na área de tecnologia. Experiência com Linux / bash scripting. Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language. Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills. Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.
